vivienne_suit_alternative.verdict: Usable as the single Vivienne card if continuity with current hero is preferred. Lower detail than job18 and slightly grayer backdrop; visible horizontal hardware, inward straps and braid agree at overview scale.
vivienne_suit_alternative.avoid: vivienne-editorial-2.jpg visibly adds small gold feet absent from the selected master. Do not use all three suit frames for the three separate bag cards.

layout_notes: Torso/hand-carry composition accepted by parent; preserve the Weekender full native width, because its bag nearly reaches both sides. Do not force a narrow crop that cuts off hardware.
The images share white backdrops and neutral clothing but differ in crop and product occupancy. This is an editorial selection, not a literal physical size comparison.

No new generation is needed for the accepted torso-carry layout. Existing R40 derivatives were made with built-in image_gen; they are not newly certified as GPT Image 2 production. Any future generation must use GPT Image 2.
